City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 21, 2022 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 16, 2022 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2022-12-21 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2022-12-21 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Joint use agreement between San Dieguito Water District (SDWD) and Encinitas Ranch Golf Authority (ERGA) authorizing and permitting power connection for ERGA to SDWD power source connection box (power source) and allowing SDWD security camera placement on ERGA Assets. Contact Person: Operations Manager Gonzalez
Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" per Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment.
Authorize General Manager to execute an agreement with ERGA, permitting ERGA connection to the power source at the Jointly used Encinitas Ranch Reservoir site to power ERGA's mobile structures. In return, allow SDWD's mounted security camera on ERGA's driving range safety net poles, for the purpose of securely monitoring the entrances to SDWD reservoir.
2022-12-21 SDWD Item S08D ERGA- SDWD Joint Use Agreement
8E.
First Amendment to Communications Site License Agreement between San Dieguito Water District, Santa Fe Irrigation District and Verizon Wireless (VAW) LLC. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board of Directors, the authorization for the General Manager to execute an amendment to a Site License Agreement, is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" per Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment.
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute the first amendment to a Verizon Communications Site License Agreement for operation of a cellular antenna at the R.E. Badger Water Filtration Plant; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to process and execute future related Site License documents.
2022-12-21 SDWD Item S08E Verizon Lease Agreement SFID-SDWD
8F.
Approval of the 2023 San Dieguito Water District Board meeting schedule. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors, approval of the 2023 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule, is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment.
District Board adopt Resolution 2022-15, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving the 2023 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule."
2022-12-21 SDWD Item S08F Approve 2023 Board Meeting Schedule
S9.

Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.

S11.

General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 18, 2023
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
